mark_scheme.criterion: States the product of mass and velocity. Reject product of mass and speed.

hints: State the two quantities that are multiplied together to define momentum.
Ensure you specify velocity, not speed.
solution: Linear momentum is the product of mass and velocity.
teacher_walkthrough: Emphasize the exact syllabus wording: product of mass and velocity.
Remind candidates that writing speed instead of velocity loses the mark.
